split_justification.context_rule: If the context runs short, work stops before the commit and reports, rather than leaving finished work unsecured or committing it unverified.
split_justification.reason: B1 stays deliberately small: one functional commit carries the visible goal, the determinative commit carries only evidence of the run against it. A genuine functional defect found by the live run creates a further functional commit with a machine-readable reason here, never an amend.
split_justification.separation: normative and determinative stay in separate branch commits; position 1 is functional, position 2 is determinative
